agents.name: Branch Context Mapper
agents.description: Advisory helper that maps a branch type to a changelog category and version-bump hint. It does not detect breaking changes or fully validate Git branch names

tools.name: branch-context-mapper.cjs
tools.description: Core branch analysis and mapping implementation

agents.name: Changelog Validator
agents.description: Basic helper check that a changelog has a title and a version heading, plus manual guidance for governance review. The helper score, governance fields and release-readiness flag are placeholders; quality and release readiness need manual review

tools.name: validate-changelog.cjs
tools.description: Basic changelog title and version-heading check

agents.name: Changelog Link Verifier
agents.description: Read-only check that every changelog entry has an adjacent PR link and issue link (Linear or GitHub). It checks link presence and adjacency only, does not fetch links, and accepts the release-agent handoff fields (version, release issue, PR list, changelog path)

tools.name: verify-changelog-links.ts
tools.description: Reports every entry missing a PR link or issue link and exits non-zero on failure

agents.name: Changelog Summariser
agents.description: Read-only condensing of a large changelog into a summary, or extraction of one release's notes, keeping every entry's PR and issue links. It reads only the changelog, prints to standard output and publishes nothing; multi-channel release communication stays with the release skill

tools.name: summarise-changelog.ts
tools.description: Prints a condensed changelog summary or one release's notes as Markdown or JSON

workflows.name: Feature Development
workflows.description: Standard workflow for developing a new feature with proper changelog entry
steps: Create feature/ branch with proper naming convention
Branch-context-mapper maps the branch type to a changelog category hint
Develop feature with tests (TDD: red → green → refactor)
Run npm test to verify 90%+ coverage
Add changelog entry in [Unreleased] section
Changelog-validator runs the basic check; review quality manually
Commit with validated message (lefthook validates)
Open PR with auto-routed template
Merge when changelog validates and tests pass

workflows.name: Bug Fix Workflow
workflows.description: Process for fixing bugs with proper traceability
steps: Create fix/ branch following conventions
Branch-context-mapper maps the branch type to the Fixed category
Write failing test reproducing the bug
Implement fix until test passes
Run full test suite (90%+ coverage required)
Add changelog entry explaining what was fixed
Changelog-validator runs the basic check; review quality manually
Commit and push with validated message
Open PR; merge when all checks pass

workflows.name: Security Fix Workflow
steps: Create security/ branch with vulnerability details
Branch-context-mapper maps the branch type to the Security category
Implement fix with test coverage
Add changelog entry: 'Fixed [VULNERABILITY] that allowed [IMPACT]'
Review clarity and completeness manually; the helper runs the basic check only
Commit with security context in message
Open PR requesting immediate review
Fast-track merge when security team approves

workflows.name: Release Preparation
workflows.description: Validate changelog and prepare for semantic version release
steps: Verify [Unreleased] section contains all changes
Run changelog-validator on the changelog (the helper has no --release-version option)
Review entry quality manually (the helper score is a fixed placeholder)
Review governance principles manually (immutability, atomicity, etc.)
Move entries to version section (e.g., [1.2.0] - 2026-10-31)
Create release PR with updated CHANGELOG.md
Merge release PR and create git tag
Generate release notes from validated changelog

workflows.name: Complete CI/CD Pipeline
workflows.description: Target pipeline from branch to release (proposed; this repository contains no CI workflow, and the helpers do not enforce quality or governance gates)
steps: Developer pushes to feature/ branch
Pre-commit hook: branch validation, tests, changelog check
CI runs: Jest (90%+), BATS (100%), linting
PR created with routed template based on branch type
Changelog-validator runs the basic check
Target CI gate: tests pass at the configured coverage threshold
Team review: changelog quality, code quality, governance
Merge: all gates passed, changelog ready
Release: changelog validated, semantic version bumped, tagged

phase1.description: Basic helpers (a fixed branch-type list and a title/version-heading check) and Lefthook configuration; the six governance principles are manual review guidance

phase2.description: Planned: remaining organisation branch types, broader rule checks, YAML field validation, PR template routing

phase3.description: GitHub Actions automation, team rollout, continuous improvement

qualityGates.name: Test Coverage
qualityGates.description: Configured 90%+ coverage threshold (lines, functions, branches, statements); a configured value, not a measured result

qualityGates.name: BATS Pass Rate
qualityGates.description: 100% of BATS integration tests must pass

qualityGates.name: Changelog Quality Score
qualityGates.description: Manual gate (unimplemented in the helper): the helper returns a fixed placeholder score and does not compute quality, so reviewers must assess it manually

qualityGates.name: Governance Compliance
qualityGates.description: Manual gate (unimplemented in the helper): review the six governance principles (immutability, atomicity, consistency, completeness, clarity, traceability) manually; the helper does not enforce them
